call_memory.statement: Capital expenditure for FY27 is guided to be INR60 crores to INR70 crores.

lab.quote: Our new age business has emerged as a strong growth engine, crossing INR100 crores in quarterly revenue for the second consecutive quarter, and growing over 100% year-on-year in Q4.

call_memory.statement: Gross margins expanded to 28% in Q4 FY26 driven by portfolio mix, disciplined pricing, and cost controls.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: In core categories, there was a volume decline of 3% in Q4 FY26.

lab.quote: we are somewhere between 14% to 15% market share in the protein segment.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Avvatar holds between 14% to 15% market share in the protein segment in quick commerce and marketplaces.

lab.quote: the change in the remuneration for executive directors is roughly around INR9-odd crores. That is for the full year from a base year of INR6 crores to almost a INR15 crores number. That is one. Secondly, the overall impact on account of ESOP is almost around INR5 crores.

call_memory.statement: The change in remuneration for executive directors is roughly INR9 crores and the ESOP impact is almost INR5 crores in FY26.

lab.quote: But of course, it's going to be a gradual move towards becoming INR1,000 crores portfolio.

lab.quote: So we are adding every quarter about 30,000 outlets as per GT is concerned in terms of all across India.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company is adding about 30,000 general trade outlets every quarter across India.

lab.quote: But of course, for the last 2 months or last 3 months, everything has been pretty much on hold, and we've been working and selling directly to the distributors now and not be able to open the depot.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Plans to open a company-owned depot in the Middle East are currently on hold due to regional uncertainty.

timeline.summary: Parag Milk Foods received a request from Vitalia Tradeglob Private Limited for re-classification from promoter group to public category.
Parag Milk Foods Limited schedules earnings call on May 8, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST to discuss Q4 and FY2026 performance with investors and analysts via conference call.
India Ratings upgraded Parag Milk Foods's NCDs and bank loans to IND BBB+/Stable and short-term rating to IND A2, while withdrawing the issuer rating.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹945.34 Cr (+3.0% YoY), net profit ₹32.24 Cr (+23.0% YoY).
Parag Milk Foods released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, reporting revenue of ₹3,818 Cr and PAT of ₹141 Cr.
Parag Milk Foods submitted the monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, detailing ₹40.30 Cr received from preferential warrants.
Parag Milk Foods Ltd’s Avvatar brand launches **Avvatar Protein Cold Coffee** in India’s first Tetra Prisma® Aseptic 250E pack, priced at ₹120, on May 12, 2026.
Parag Milk Foods held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 8, 2026, highlighting New Age business traction and gross margin resilience.

Parag Milk Foods issued a corrigendum on May 15, 2026, adding the delegation to its Finance Committee for allotment of 10,00,000 ESOP shares to the ESOP Trust, which would raise paid-up capital to ₹126.11 Cr.
Parag Milk Foods fully redeemed ₹71.83 Cr of NCDs from IFC on October 30, 2026, prior to maturity
Parag Milk Foods Limited invites investors to an earnings conference call on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 2:00 PM IST.
